headline: Epoch AI, a group that tests AI systems, has set 50 unsolved mathematics problems as a computer-checkable test of whether AI can make real discoveries.
score_reason: Useful background and a clear test design, but the list dates from July and the piece is a feature.
importance_line: Mathematicians and AI labs now have a shared test where answers are checked by software, though only three of 50 problems were reported solved by 31 July.
summary: India Today reports that Epoch AI's FrontierMath: Open Problems list, chosen by mathematicians at June workshops in six cities, now holds 50 research problems, each paired with a computer program that can check a proposed answer. By 31 July Epoch said AI had solved three of them, and in September researchers reported a proof for a core problem in approval-based committee elections, obtained with GPT-6 Astra and checked in the Lean proof tool.
notes: Feature published 4 Oct 2026 about a July list; lowered 6 to 5 as not new today.
